items.title: Gus Fontenet Interview
items.q: His mother was a singer. She was a piano player and a singer too.

ctx.x: His mother was a singer. Uh-huh. I, I, I did most of my practice in the barbershop. We were, we worked together in the barbershop and every chance I would get, I would sit out and go to practice. And we kind of got on this load. He was, I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. This was, uh. It was my, my, yes. My aunt.
His mother was a singer. She was a piano player and a singer too. Oh, oh, oh.

My aunt. What's your, what's my aunt, you know, she, she was, in a way, she bought the first instrument that I played. Is that right? Right. She, she, she had it with a wonderful voice in the group.
